events.summary: iOS 12 Beta 3 is represented by 37 Apple-documented new or resolved issue records from the dated developer PDF; cumulative known issues, community observations, and build claims are excluded.

blocks.text: A complete text rendering of Apple's dated iOS 12 beta 3 developer PDF survives online. It identifies the SDK state, labels each component, separates New Issues from Resolved Issues, retains Apple's internal issue identifiers, and carries an Apple copyright footer dated July 3, 2018.

citations.locator: iOS 12 beta 3 Release Notes; About iOS 12 beta 3; pages 2–9

citations.note: Used only to corroborate document identity and timing.

blocks.text: The structured record covers 37 milestone-specific additions and resolutions spanning installation, application compatibility, accessibility, AirPods, ARKit, authentication, Calendar, CallKit, CarPlay, iWork, telephony and FaceTime, Screen Time, Siri, Spotlight, and Wallet.

blocks.text: Only entries beneath the PDF's exact New Issues and Resolved Issues headings are included. Generic Known Issues, generic New Features, deprecations, community-discovered changes, and any item without a retained issue identifier are excluded, so the page does not convert a cumulative beta document into an invented release delta.

blocks.text: In 2018 Apple published one iOS SDK document for iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch. This route therefore retains iPad-specific Beta 3 records where Apple's iOS document explicitly includes them; it does not invent a separate historical iPadOS route.

citations.locator: About iOS 12 beta 3 — iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch

blocks.text: Apple's modern DocC page preserves the final iOS 12 SDK note state rather than a browsable set of 2018 beta revisions. The public Beta 3 evidence is an Apple-authored document retained by third-party mirrors, so each occurrence remains source-linked and corroborated pending editorial review. No build number is taken from a forum post or inferred from an unavailable Apple download.
